summary: Comprehensive UI testing of StudyFlow Expo web app on 390x844 mobile viewport. All 15 requested flows verified as PASSING: home loads with level/XP/daily goal ring/metrics, bottom tabs navigate correctly, Start Studying routes to Timer, preset 25/5 and 50/10 update clock, Custom bottom sheet steppers apply (30:00 verified), timer start/pause/resume/reset state machine works, Tasks FAB + New Task sheet + subject/due chips + Add Task, task toggle awards +50 XP and increments Home 'Tasks Today', filter chips (All/Active/Completed) filter correctly, task delete works, Settings > Manage Subjects lists 6 defaults and add works, Settings > Daily Study Goal 1h option updates row, Reset All Data restores defaults, Statistics Metrics tab renders weekly chart, Achievements tab renders 6 badges, and task persistence across page reload confirmed. Note: bottom tab label reads 'Stats' (not 'Statistics'), which is minor. Non-blocking console deprecation warning noticed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from home hero LinearGradient scrim.

issues: Bottom tab labeled 'Stats' instead of 'Statistics' — inconsistent with the screen title 'Statistics'. Cosmetic naming choice, not a bug.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `pointerEvents` prop instead of `style.pointerEvents`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:126

action_items: Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents on the LinearGradient scrim in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:126 to remove the RN deprecation warning.
Optional: unify bottom tab label to 'Statistics' (currently 'Stats') to match screen header for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext unlocks a 'level_five' achievement id which does not appear to be defined in ACHIEVEMENTS spec ('Rising Scholar' is mentioned in the PRD); verify defaults.ts has matching id or update the unlock check. Reference: /app/frontend/src/store/AppContext.tsx:212

TimerContext has a stale-closure risk on `progress` since `totalMsRef.current` is a ref read inside useMemo — currently works because remainingMs re-triggers memo, but could be brittle if presets change while running (guarded by early-return in setPreset).
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted transient TEST tasks and 'TEST Subject'; cleaned up via Reset All Data at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy paths pass. Bottom tab labels use short names (Home/Tasks/Timer/Stats/Settings). When navigating via text selectors, use 'Stats' not 'Statistics'. AsyncStorage persists tasks/subjects/profile correctly across web reloads. Timer full-session completion was intentionally not exercised.
